about: Character files for the Alter Egos popup (owner, 4 Nov 2026: 'Study of the character, Character sketch, Character Arc/Journey, Famous lines by the character ... Later will get SRK to talk about each character, his process'). Keyed by film id (same as data/srk-characters.json and the poster set). Fields: type, director, cast[], sketch, arc[start, turning point, end], lines[{q, ctx}] (only lines we are sure of; short), traits[], impact, words (SRK on the role: empty until he records it). Films without a file show the basic popup. Our own words; facts from the films and the public record.

027.sketch: Raj Malhotra is a rich, cheeky London boy, raised by a doting father, who has never had to work for anything. Under the jokes he is decent to the core: he will not take what is not given.
arc: A carefree NRI on a Europe trip with his friends, teasing a serious girl called Simran on the train.
He falls for her, then learns her father has already promised her to a man in Punjab. He follows her to India.
He refuses to elope. He wins her family over and waits until her father himself lets her go: 'Ja Simran, ja.'

lines.q: Bade bade deshon mein aisi chhoti chhoti baatein hoti rehti hain, Senorita.
lines.ctx: To Simran, brushing off a small mishap on their European trip.
Raj wills Simran to turn back and look at him: if she loves him, she will.

027.impact: Ran at Mumbai's Maratha Mandir for more than 1,000 weeks and set the template for the NRI romance of the next decade.

020.sketch: Rahul Mehra is a lonely, intense young man who has decided that Kiran is his, though she has never been his. He stammers her name and talks to his dead mother.
arc: A college classmate who watches Kiran from a distance and calls her without speaking.
Kiran marries Sunil. Rahul's obsession turns into stalking, threats and violence.
He follows them to their honeymoon to take her by force and dies in the fight with Sunil.

lines.ctx: His stammering refrain, said to her and to himself.

020.impact: The stalker became the character audiences remembered; the newcomer stole the film from its hero.

019.sketch: Ajay Sharma grew up watching Madan Chopra ruin his father and his family. He becomes Vicky Malhotra, charming and cold, with one goal: take everything back.
arc: A boy who saw his family lose its home and his father die after Madan Chopra's betrayal.
He seduces and kills Chopra's daughter Seema, then courts her sister Priya to get inside the family.
He takes back his father's company and kills Chopra, but is fatally wounded and dies in his mother's arms.

lines.q: Kabhi kabhi kuch jeetne ke liye kuch haarna padta hai. Aur haar kar jeetne wale ko Baazigar kehte hain.
lines.ctx: His creed: sometimes you lose to win, and the one who wins by losing is a Baazigar.

019.impact: A hero who kills, and the audience stayed with him. It won him his first Filmfare Best Actor award.

022.sketch: Vijay Agnihotri is a rich young man who has never heard 'no'. When Shivani marries another man, his wanting turns into a campaign to destroy her.
arc: A wealthy heir who falls for an air hostess, Shivani.
She marries someone else. Vijay frames her and ruins her family to make her his.
Shivani, broken and in prison, finally turns on him and ends it.
022.impact: His most frightening role; it won him the Filmfare award for Best Performance in a Negative Role.

041.sketch: Rahul Khanna is the star of his college: sporty, funny, sure of himself. He does not see that his tomboy best friend Anjali loves him until it is almost too late.
arc: In college Anjali is his best friend, but he falls for the new girl, Tina, and marries her.
Tina dies after childbirth and leaves letters for their daughter, who sets out to reunite her father with Anjali.
Years later he meets Anjali again, now engaged to someone else, and finally understands what he felt.

lines.ctx: His idea of love: love is friendship.

041.impact: Defined the late-90s campus romance: the friendship band, the 'Cool' T-shirt and a generation's idea of first love.

037.sketch: Rahul is a Mumbai theatre director who does not believe in destiny or in 'the one'. His best friend and lead dancer Nisha loves him; he is waiting for someone he has not met.
arc: A stage director who laughs at the idea of a love made in heaven.
Pooja joins his musical. He falls for her while Nisha, hurt, steps aside.
On opening night he chooses Pooja, and his own story becomes the show.

lines.ctx: His swaggering introduction: you must have heard the name.

037.impact: 'Rahul' became his signature name across a dozen films.

053.sketch: Devdas Mukherjee comes home from London to the girl he has loved since childhood, Paro. Proud, weak-willed and wounded, he cannot defy his family and cannot forgive himself.
arc: He returns from England to Paro and their childhood love.
Families and pride keep them apart; Paro is married off. He turns to drink and to the courtesan Chandramukhi.
Dying, he keeps his promise to see Paro one last time and collapses at her gate.

lines.q: Kaun kambakht hai jo bardasht karne ke liye peeta hai?
lines.ctx: His answer when asked why he drinks.

053.impact: Screened at Cannes in 2002 and nominated for the BAFTA for Best Film Not in the English Language.

051.sketch: Rahul Raichand is the adopted elder son of a rich, proud family: dutiful, adored, the heir. He believes family and love can live together, until his father makes him choose.
arc: The perfect son, who brings his father's word to everything.
He marries Anjali, a girl from Chandni Chowk, against his father's wishes and is cast out. He leaves for London.
Years later his younger brother Rohan finds him and brings the family back together.
051.impact: The big family melodrama of the NRI era: duty, class and the son who had to leave home.

057.sketch: Aman Mathur arrives in New York and fixes everyone's life with jokes and nerve. He hides one thing: his heart is failing and he does not have long.
arc: A loud, warm newcomer who teaches a grieving family, and the serious Naina, to laugh again.
Naina falls for him. Knowing he is dying, he pushes her towards his friend Rohit.
He dies having given everyone around him a future he will not have.
057.impact: Put mortality at the centre of a big Hindi romance.

060.sketch: Squadron Leader Veer Pratap Singh is an Indian Air Force rescue pilot: gentle, rooted, from a Punjab village. He meets Zaara, a girl from Pakistan, and never stops loving her.
arc: A pilot who rescues Zaara after a bus accident and shows her his village and his family.
He goes to Pakistan for her, is jailed under a false name and stays silent to protect her honour.
After 22 years a young lawyer, Saamiya, tells his story in court and he walks free to find Zaara waiting.

lines.ctx: The opening of his poem in court: a prisoner known only by a number.

060.impact: A love story across the India-Pakistan border told without hate.

061.sketch: Mohan Bhargava is a NASA project manager with a good life in America. He comes back to find the woman who raised him, Kaveri Amma, and finds a country he had stopped looking at.
arc: A successful scientist who visits India only to take his old nanny back to America.
In the village of Charanpur he sees poverty, caste and darkness, and starts to help.
He builds a small power station on a stream, the bulbs light up, and he chooses to stay.
061.impact: Turned the 'should I go back home?' question into public talk for a generation of Indians abroad.

070.sketch: Kabir Khan was India's hockey captain until a final against Pakistan was lost on his penalty. Branded a traitor, he spends seven years in disgrace, then asks to coach the women's team nobody wants.
arc: A disgraced former captain whose home is defaced after a loss to Pakistan.
He takes on a divided women's team and makes them play for one name only: India.
They win the World Cup in Australia, and his name is cleared.

lines.ctx: His speech before the final: seventy minutes, the length of a hockey match.

070.impact: 'Chak De' became India's sports anthem, and women's hockey had a hit film.

072.sketch: Om Prakash Makhija is a junior artist in 1970s Bombay who dreams of being a star and loves the actress Shanti from afar. Reborn thirty years later, he is Om Kapoor, the superstar he wanted to be.
arc: A background extra who loves the star Shantipriya and watches her from the crowd.
He sees her killed by producer Mukesh Mehra in a burning studio and dies trying to save her.
Reborn as Om Kapoor, he remembers, and stages a film to make the killer confess.

lines.q: Picture abhi baaki hai, mere dost.
lines.ctx: The film-within-the-film's promise: the picture is not over yet.

lines.q: Ek chutki sindoor ki keemat tum kya jaano, Ramesh babu?
lines.ctx: Om playing a melodrama heroine's line on set.

072.impact: A love letter to 70s Bollywood and the outsider's anthem; 'Picture abhi baaki hai' became his own motto.

068.sketch: Don is the head of a drug syndicate wanted across Asia: cool, ruthless, always a step ahead. Vijay is a gentle look-alike recruited by the police to take his place.
arc: Don runs his empire from Malaysia while the police close in.
He is shot; the police send in Vijay as Don to bring the gang down.
The twist: the man who comes back is not who he seems, and Don walks away.

lines.q: Don ko pakadna mushkil hi nahin, naamumkin hai.
lines.ctx: Catching Don is not just difficult, it is impossible.

068.impact: Remade Amitabh Bachchan's 1978 Don for a new generation and started a franchise.

081.sketch: Rizwan Khan has Asperger's syndrome. He sees the world literally, cannot lie and hates the colour yellow. In San Francisco he marries Mandira, a single mother, and builds a family.
arc: A man from Mumbai who moves to America and marries Mandira, a Hindu single mother.
After 9/11 her son Sameer is killed in a hate attack because of the Khan name; Mandira blames Rizwan.
He walks across America to tell the President one sentence, and helps flood victims on the way.

lines.q: My name is Khan, and I am not a terrorist.
lines.ctx: The sentence he crosses America to deliver.

081.impact: Took post-9/11 Islamophobia and a neurodivergent hero to a worldwide audience.

077.sketch: Surinder Sahni is a shy, plain Punjab Power office clerk who marries Taani after her father's death. To win her, he invents a second self: Raj, loud, stylish and nothing like him.
arc: A timid clerk in an arranged marriage with a young woman who cannot love him.
With a new look he becomes 'Raj', joins her dance class and becomes her friend.
Taani chooses her husband, Surinder, because she sees God in him.
077.impact: Made an ordinary, unglamorous man the romantic hero.

087.sketch: Samar Anand is an army bomb-disposal expert who never wears a protective suit. Ten years earlier he was a busker in London who fell in love with Meera.
arc: In London he and Meera fall in love; she promises God she will give him up if he survives an accident.
He survives, she leaves, and he joins the Indian Army to defuse bombs, daring death every day.
A documentary maker, Akira, brings him back to London, where his past and Meera wait.
087.impact: Yash Chopra's last film, and his first on-screen kiss after twenty years.

090.sketch: Rahul Mithaiwala is a forty-year-old sweet-shop heir from Mumbai, unmarried and unadventurous. He is meant to scatter his grandfather's ashes in Rameswaram but plans a Goa holiday instead.
arc: He boards the Chennai Express, meaning to slip away to Goa.
He helps Meenamma onto the train and is pulled into her escape from a family match in Tamil Nadu.
In her village he stands up to her family and wins her.

lines.q: Don't underestimate the power of a common man.
lines.ctx: His line when he finally stands up for himself.

090.impact: One of the biggest Hindi hits of 2013.

096.sketch: Gaurav Chandna runs a cyber cafe in Delhi and looks like his idol, the superstar Aryan Khanna. Aryan is a real star with real flaws; Gaurav believes he has the right to him.
arc: Gaurav wins a lookalike contest and travels to Mumbai to meet Aryan on his birthday.
Aryan rejects him. Gaurav turns his worship into a campaign to destroy Aryan's name.
Star and fan face each other; Gaurav dies having become everything his idol was not.
096.impact: A superstar looked at his own fans, and at himself, in one film.

098.sketch: Dr. Jehangir Khan, 'Dr. Jug', is a Goa counsellor who listens more than he speaks. He helps the young cinematographer Kaira face her anger and her childhood.
arc: Kaira, sleepless and restless, walks into his sessions half-mocking.
Through walks by the sea and simple games he helps her talk about being left as a child.
She heals, and he lets her go: a good therapist is not a love story.

lines.q: Genius woh nahin jiske paas har sawaal ka jawaab ho. Genius woh hai jiske paas har jawaab tak pahunchne ka patience ho.
lines.ctx: To Kaira: genius is the patience to reach every answer.

098.impact: Brought therapy and mental health into mainstream Hindi cinema.

100.sketch: Raees Alam grows up poor in Gujarat, where liquor is banned, and becomes its biggest bootlegger. Generous to his people, he lives by his mother's rule that no business is small.
arc: A boy carrying liquor for a bootlegger, with a mother who tells him no work is beneath him.
He builds his own empire and becomes a hero to his neighbourhood, chased by the honest officer Majmudar.
Smuggled goods he trusted turn out to be explosives for a bombing; guilty, he surrenders and is killed.

lines.q: Baniye ka dimaag aur Miyanbhai ki daring.
lines.ctx: How he sums himself up: a trader's brain and a street fighter's nerve.

100.impact: His return to the outlaw role, and a lasting duel with Nawazuddin Siddiqui.

104.sketch: Bauua Singh is a man with dwarfism from Meerut: loud, rude, hilarious and desperate to be loved. He falls for Aafia, a scientist with cerebral palsy, and for a film star at the same time.
arc: A small-town show-off who meets Aafia through a marriage bureau.
He runs from their wedding, chasing a dance contest and the star Babita.
He is chosen for a mission to Mars; the film leaves his return to Aafia open.
104.impact: A disabled lead in a big star film; it did not do well and came before his long silence.

111.sketch: Pathaan is an Indian spy with no surname, an abandoned child raised by the country he serves. He was given the name Pathaan by an Afghan village he once saved.
arc: A RAW agent who was left for dead after a mission and runs a unit of injured agents.
He hunts Jim, a former agent turned terrorist, across continents, with the ISI agent Rubina.
He stops Jim's attack on India and saves the country again.

lines.q: Kursi ki peti baandh lo, mausam bigadne wala hai.
lines.ctx: Fasten your seat belts, the weather is about to turn.

111.impact: His return after more than four years without a lead role, and one of the biggest Hindi hits.

113.sketch: Azad Rathore is a jailer who leads a team of women prisoners in a fight against corruption. Vikram Rathore is his father, a soldier betrayed by an arms dealer.
arc: Azad hijacks a Mumbai metro and asks a rich man for money to clear farmers' loans.
His father Vikram's story comes out: a soldier framed by the arms dealer Kaalie.
Father and son together bring Kaalie down and ask voters to question their leaders.

lines.q: Bete ko haath lagaane se pehle baap se baat kar.
lines.ctx: Before you touch the son, talk to the father.

113.impact: A mass action film that ended with a direct message to voters.

115.sketch: Hardy (Hardayal Singh Dhillon) is a soldier who comes to a Punjab village to thank a man who saved his life. He stays to help Manu and her friends reach London.
arc: He arrives to repay a debt and finds friends who cannot get visas.
They take the illegal 'donkey route' through deserts and borders; not all survive.
Decades later, old, they try to come home the same way.
115.impact: Put illegal migration and the donkey route into public talk.

013.sketch: Raj Mathur is a civil engineering graduate from Darjeeling who comes to Bombay with big dreams and small pockets. Honest and eager, he wants to become a gentleman.
arc: A small-town boy who arrives in Bombay, finds a room in a chawl and falls for Renu.
A job at a construction company lifts him fast; success and his boss's niece Sapna start to change him.
Faced with his bosses' corrupt deal, he chooses honesty and Renu over the high life.
013.impact: The small-town boy in the big city: millions of migrants to Bombay saw themselves in Raju.

011.sketch: Raja Sahay is a rich, reckless young man who falls for Kajal, a widow, and marries her against his family's wishes.
arc: The spoilt son of a powerful businessman who meets the grieving widow Kajal.
He wins her over and marries her.
Her first husband Ravi turns out to be alive, and love, duty and loyalty collide.
011.impact: His first film release, which won him the Filmfare award for Best Male Debut.

023.sketch: Arjun is one of two brothers murdered by their uncle Durjan for their land. Reborn as Vijay, a carefree young man in the city, he does not know who he was.
arc: Arjun and his brother Karan are killed by Durjan; their mother prays for their return.
Reborn as Vijay and Ajay, the brothers meet and slowly remember their past lives.
They return to their mother and take revenge on Durjan.
023.impact: The reincarnation revenge classic and his first pairing with Salman Khan as brothers.

021.sketch: Sunil is a lovable failure in Goa: a musician in a struggling band, a disappointment to his father, and hopelessly in love with Anna, who loves his friend Chris.
arc: A dreamer who fails exams and plays in a band with Chris and Anna.
He lies, schemes and plays tricks to come between Anna and Chris.
He does the right thing and brings them together, and at the very end meets someone new.
021.impact: A rare Hindi romance in which the hero does not get the girl.

036.sketch: Arjun Sagar is the adopted son of Kishorilal, an Indian businessman in America. A musician, loyal and warm, he is sent to India to arrange a bride for Kishorilal's son.
arc: He goes to India to win over Ganga for Rajiv, Kishorilal's son.
In America Ganga finds Rajiv cruel, and she and Arjun fall in love.
He brings her back to India and stands up to the family that raised him.
036.impact: Subhash Ghai's NRI-versus-Indian-values drama, and Mahima Chaudhry's debut.

035.sketch: Rahul Joshi is an ambitious junior employee who does whatever his boss asks to get ahead, including covering up the boss's affairs.
arc: A yes-man who dreams of his own business and helps his boss chase women.
He falls for Seema, the very girl his boss is chasing.
He chooses love and his self-respect over the promotion.
035.impact: A light comedy of ambition against love, and another Aziz Mirza film with Juhi Chawla.

034.sketch: Shankar is the mute servant of a cruel landlord. He cannot speak, so the whole role is played with his eyes and his body.
arc: The landlord uses Shankar's photograph to trick Gauri into marriage.
Shankar learns the truth and helps Gauri escape.
Hunted, they fight back and Shankar defeats the landlord.

040.sketch: Amarkant Varma is an All India Radio journalist who falls instantly for a mysterious woman on a railway platform. She is Meghna, and she is part of a plot to set off a bomb.
arc: A radio reporter who meets Meghna in the rain and cannot forget her.
He follows her across the country, while his family arranges his marriage to Preeti.
He learns Meghna is a suicide bomber and dies holding her.
040.impact: The last film in Mani Ratnam's trilogy after Roja and Bombay, and the 'Chaiyya Chaiyya' song on a moving train.

047.sketch: Raj Aryan Malhotra is a music teacher who comes to Gurukul, a strict school run by Narayan Shankar. He believes in love; the school forbids it.
arc: He joins Gurukul as a violin teacher and teaches three students to follow their hearts.
His past comes out: he loved Narayan's daughter Megha, who took her life after her father threw him out.
Narayan finally accepts that fear lost him his daughter, and hands the school over.
047.impact: His first film with Amitabh Bachchan, the father-figure he faced across the whole film.

050.sketch: Asoka is a Mauryan prince: brave, impatient and loved by the people. His step-brothers see him as a threat.
arc: He leaves the palace in disguise and falls in love with Kaurwaki, a princess of Kalinga in hiding.
He returns, believes her dead, and grows ruthless on his way to the throne.
After the war of Kalinga he walks among the dead and gives up violence.
050.impact: He played Emperor Ashoka in a film produced by his own company, Dreamz Unlimited.

059.sketch: Major Ram Prasad Sharma is an army officer who goes undercover as a college student to protect a general's daughter, and to find the half-brother he has never met.
arc: A commando given a mission at a Darjeeling college, posing as a much older student.
He falls for the chemistry teacher Chandni and wins over his brother Lakshman.
He stops the former soldier Raghavan and reunites his family.
059.impact: The first film produced by Red Chillies Entertainment, and Farah Khan's first film as director.

056.sketch: Raj Mathur runs a small trucking business and is happy-go-lucky until he meets Priya, an elegant designer from a different world.
arc: He woos Priya, gets her to break off her engagement, and marries her.
Money troubles and small fights wear the marriage down.
Priya leaves for Greece; he follows and they find their way back.
056.impact: A love story about what comes after the wedding.

067.sketch: Dev Saran was a football star until an accident ended his career. Bitter and angry, he is married to a successful editor, Rhea, and feels small beside her.
arc: A wounded man who meets Maya, who is about to marry Rishi, and talks her into it.
Years later, both unhappily married, they fall in love and have an affair.
They leave their marriages and, after time apart, find each other again.
067.impact: A star romance about infidelity in marriage, set in New York.

065.sketch: Kishanlal is a merchant's son who leaves his bride on their wedding night to do business. A ghost who saw her falls in love and takes Kishanlal's form.
arc: The ghost tells Lachchi the truth and lives with her as her husband, kindly.
The real Kishanlal comes home and the village cannot tell the two apart.
A shepherd tricks the ghost into a leather bag, and Lachchi is left with her choice.
065.impact: India's official entry for the Academy Awards in 2006.

079.sketch: Sahir Khan is a film superstar who comes to shoot in a small village. Billu, the village barber, was his childhood friend, but is too shy to say so.
arc: The village hears that Billu knows the star and everyone wants something from him.
Billu cannot reach Sahir and the village turns on him.
At a school event Sahir tells everyone that Billu is his oldest friend.
079.impact: He played a version of himself: the star who remembers where he came from.

085.sketch: Shekhar Subramaniam is a geeky video-game designer in London who wants his son Prateek to see him as a hero. He builds a game with a villain who cannot lose: Ra.One.
arc: Shekhar creates Ra.One and the hero G.One for his son.
Ra.One escapes into the real world and kills Shekhar.
G.One, with Shekhar's face, protects the family and defeats Ra.One.
085.impact: A superhero film built on visual effects, which built up Red Chillies VFX.

086.sketch: Don is back: the crime lord who rules the Asian drug trade sets his eyes on Europe.
arc: He surrenders to the police in Malaysia, on his own terms.
He breaks out with his old enemy Vardhaan and plans to rob a bank in Berlin.
He gets what he came for and outwits the police again.
086.impact: The second chapter of the Don series, shot in Berlin.

093.sketch: Charlie is a street fighter in Mumbai whose father was framed and jailed by the rich Charan Grover. He has spent his life planning revenge.
arc: He says every door to an honest, legal living in the city has closed on him; he plans a diamond heist.
He builds a team of misfits who must enter a world dance championship in Dubai.
The heist and the dance both succeed, and his father's name is cleared.
093.impact: His line about honest doors is studied at KING University: is a bad man born, or made?

095.sketch: Raj runs a car-modification shop in Goa and lives to protect his younger brother Veer. Fifteen years ago he was Kaali, a gangster in Bulgaria.
arc: A quiet garage owner whose brother falls for Ishita.
Ishita's sister is Meera, the woman he loved and lost in Bulgaria when their gang families went to war.
The old enemies meet again and Raj and Meera find their way back.
095.impact: His return with Kajol on screen.

102.sketch: Harry is a Punjabi tour guide in Europe: charming with tourists and lonely when they leave. He cannot go home.
arc: Sejal loses her engagement ring on his tour and makes him help find it.
City after city they search, and fall in love.
He finally lets himself want something, and goes home.
102.impact: Imtiaz Ali's travel romance across Europe.

042.sketch: Raj Heera, who calls himself Baadshah, runs a small detective agency and dreams of being a real secret agent.
arc: A bumbling private eye hired to keep an eye on a rich man's daughter, Seema.
He stumbles into a plot to assassinate the Chief Minister.
He stops the plot and wins the girl.
042.impact: Another hit with Abbas-Mustan, this time as a comic hero.

045.sketch: Max Dias is the leader of the Eagles, a street gang in Vasco, Goa, and the fiercely protective twin brother of Shirley.
arc: The Eagles rule one side of town; the Bichhoo gang the other.
Shirley falls for Rahul, brother of the rival gang's leader.
The feud between the two gangs comes to a head, and Max has to protect his sister and his town.
045.impact: A Goan gang drama, with Aishwarya Rai as his twin sister.

001.sketch: Lieutenant Abhimanyu Rai is a young cadet in commando training: cocky, quick, and learning what the uniform asks of him.
arc: A new recruit who arrives with more attitude than discipline.
Commando training breaks him down and builds him up with his platoon.
He becomes the soldier the training was meant to make.
001.impact: His first role on television, on Doordarshan in 1989. India met his face here.

003.sketch: Shekharan is a young man with a travelling circus who must decide whether the circus is his life.
arc: He travels with the circus from town to town.
The circus struggles, and he takes on its troubles and its people.
He commits to the life of the tent and keeps the show going.
003.impact: His second TV serial, and the start of his long work with Aziz Mirza.

012.sketch: Sunder Srivastava is a young man from a village who comes to Bombay to make a living and is cheated on the first day.
arc: Cheated and homeless in Bombay, he spends a night in a graveyard.
He meets the ghost of a gangster, Marco, who needs his help to settle a score.
With Marco's help he finds his feet, wins love and sees Marco freed.
012.impact: An early comic lead, opposite Naseeruddin Shah.

017.sketch: Lalit is a young man drawn to Maya, a married woman who lives in her dreams and her romances.
arc: He is fascinated by the mysterious Maya.
He becomes one of her lovers as she chases a life her marriage cannot give her.
Her story ends in mystery; Lalit is left with the question of who she was.
017.impact: An art-house role based on Flaubert's Madame Bovary, early in his career.

028.sketch: Ram Jaane grew up on the street with no name of his own; asked who he was, the answer was 'Ram jaane', only God knows. He becomes a gangster.
arc: An orphan who learns that the world only respects force.
Out of prison, he returns to the neighbourhood of his childhood love and to a group of street children.
Through the children he sees a different road, and wants it for them.
028.impact: One of his 90s anti-hero roles, a gangster with a conscience.

029.sketch: Romi Singh is the youngest of three brothers whose mother was framed and jailed by a powerful villain.
arc: Their mother is jailed for a crime she did not commit.
The three brothers set out to clear her name and expose the man behind it.
Together they bring the villain down and their mother is freed.
029.impact: A multi-star action drama with Anil Kapoor and Jackie Shroff.

030.sketch: He plays three men of one family, the Mayurs, across two generations, split between England and India.
arc: An old family quarrel splits the Mayurs between England and India.
Vikram comes to India to take back his nephew and falls for Bijuria.
He chooses love and the family is made whole.

031.sketch: Roop Rathore is a singer from Rajasthan who wants to make it in Bombay and help his ailing father.
arc: He comes to the city to sing and earn.
He falls for Pooja and crosses a powerful, dangerous man.
He fights to keep his love and his dignity.
031.impact: A Mahesh Bhatt romance from his early run of leading roles.

032.sketch: Major Arjun Singh is an army officer and Sridevi's husband, whose murder sets the story in motion.
arc: An honest officer who witnesses a crime.
He is killed by the gangster he stood against.
His widow raises an army of convicts to avenge him.
032.impact: A short role whose death drives Sridevi's revenge story.

038.sketch: Bablu Chaudhry is a gentle chef who dreams of his own hotel. Manu Dada is a ruthless criminal who looks exactly like him.
arc: Bablu gets a job at a hotel and falls for Sonia.
Manu escapes from prison and uses the lookalike to hide in plain sight.
The two meet face to face, and Bablu has to beat the man who wears his face.
038.impact: A comic double role produced by Yash Johar.

043.sketch: Ajay Bakshi is a flashy, ambitious TV news reporter who will do anything for ratings.
arc: He and the rival reporter Ria compete for the same stories.
A man is to be hanged for a murder he did not commit, and the two must work together.
Ajay puts truth before ratings and saves the man.
043.impact: The first production of his company Dreamz Unlimited, a satire on TV news; it did not do well.

044.sketch: Amjad Ali Khan is an archaeologist and the old friend of Saket Ram, from their days digging at Mohenjo-daro.
arc: Saket, his friend, turns to hatred after his wife is killed in the riots of 1946.
Amjad stands for the friendship and the shared country Saket is losing faith in.
Amjad is killed in the violence, and his death helps turn Saket back.
044.impact: He took no fee for the role, as a gesture to Kamal Haasan.

049.sketch: Arun Verma is a police officer who takes in the four children of his murdered colleague.
arc: His colleague is killed; Arun is suspected.
He looks after the four orphaned children with a hired nanny, Geeta.
He clears his name and finds the real killer.
049.impact: A family action comedy with Juhi Chawla.

052.sketch: Gopal is a singer married to Radha. Insecure and jealous, he cannot believe that her friendship with another man is only friendship.
arc: Gopal and Radha are happy until her childhood friend Suraj returns.
Suspicion takes over Gopal and his marriage cracks.
He learns to trust again and the couple are reunited.
052.impact: A long-delayed film, released years after it was shot.

054.sketch: Jaisingh is a rough, good-hearted man who helps a mother, Nandini, escape with her son from a violent family.
arc: Nandini is trapped in her husband's family's village after his death.
Jaisingh helps her and the child flee.
He dies protecting them on their way out.
054.impact: A short, explosive special appearance in a Karisma Kapoor film.

055.sketch: Yashvant Rao is an IAS officer whose wife hit Suhani in an accident, the event at the heart of the film.
arc: Suhani is gravely hurt in a road accident.
Her husband learns the car was driven by the officer's wife.
Yashvant Rao takes the blame to protect his wife.
055.impact: A small cameo produced by Yash Raj Films, built on a big moment.

075.sketch: Aditya Sharma is a father who works on ships and is often away; his son Banku befriends the ghost who haunts their new house.
arc: His family moves into a house said to be haunted.
His son makes friends with the ghost, Bhoothnath.
Aditya helps find out why the ghost cannot leave.
075.impact: An extended guest role in a children's film with Amitabh Bachchan.

097.sketch: Tahir Taliyar Khan is the ex-husband of the poet Saba.
arc: Ayan comes to know Saba and her past.
Tahir and Saba meet years after their marriage ended.
He shows that some love stays, even after it ends.
097.impact: A short role with the line about one-sided love that the film was built on.
